name: Utah Code
label: Utah statutes
record_note: The Utah Code from the Legislature's archive of 2026-05-12 to the current code of 2026-10-28, via le.utah.gov; built 2026-10-28.
author: the chapter of the Laws of Utah that made the change (Law trailer)
granularity: the effective date of each text where the code or the Laws of Utah give it; otherwise the date of the first archive that prints it

scope.when_absent: the code records no case-by-case scope; a chapter's application is in the Laws of Utah

default_reach.rule: a provision of the Utah Code is not retroactive, unless the provision is expressly declared to be retroactive
